[[Kindred]] is a term used within the [[SolSeedMovement]] to refer to anyone or any organization that shares the [[GreaterMovement/Values|Values]] of the [[GreaterMovement]] of which the [[SolSeedMovement]] is a part.

See: [[Kindred 2015]]

==Featured Kindred==

=== [http://humanisticpaganism.com/ Humanistic Paganism]===
[[File: hp_logo.jpg | 100px]]

A way of life rooted in ancient Paganism and modern science. -HP Website

SolSeed is proud to have contributed to the Humanistic Paganism blog and, because of our shared naturalistic worldview, to call Humanistic Pagans Kindred.

=== [http://luf.org The Living Universe Foundation ]===
[[File: LUF_logo.jpg | 100px]]

A non-profit organization whose purpose is to ensure the eternal prosperity of life in this universe. - LUF Website

Because of our common goal of striving toward the prosperity of Life in this universe, SolSeed calls LUF Kindred.

[http://tmp2.wikia.com/wiki/Main_Page TMP2] is a LUF project to compile a comprehensive and scientifically sophisticated articulation of a very long-term plan for colonizing the galaxy.

=== [http://panspermia-society.com/contact.php SOLIS: The Society for Life in Space/The Interstellar Panspermia Society]=== 
[[File: SOLISLogo.jpg | 100px]]

Dedicated to Securing and Expanding Life in Space... -SOLIS Website

Because of our common goal of spreading Life throughout the galaxy, SolSeed calls SOLIS Kindred.

=== [http://spiritualnaturalistsociety.org/ Spiritual Naturalist Society]===
[[File: sns_logo.jpg | 100px]]

Spiritual Naturalism (also called religious naturalism) is a worldview, value system, and personal life practice. A religion to some, philosophy to others, Spiritual Naturalism sees the universe as one natural and sacred whole – as is the rationality and the science through which nature is revealed. -SNS Website

As a Naturalist Religion, SolSeed is proud to be a partner of the Spiritual Naturalist Society

=== [http://windward.org Windward Center] ===
[[File: Windwardlogo.jpg | 100px]]

A cooperative community of over thirty years in the making dedicated to preserving and developing village scale technologies needed to support a thriving sustainable community on marginal land. 

SolSeed is very interested in the maker attitude toward technology and intentional communities and sustainability and so we enthusiastically call Windward Kindred.

== Kindred Interview of [[Shelley]] ==

'''What is the purpose of Kindred 2010?'''

: To bring together people we would like to have in our network ... for example, to introduce Sequoia to their children



'''If you could meet a normal person to be friends with, or to be in a village with ... what would they be like?'''

: Interested in community
: Embrace life and personal growth
: Share "each mortal thing does one thing and the same ... happy in the sun" value
: They like kids
: They like to do stuff ... this one is super important
: They are accepting rather than judgemental
: They are curious
: They are intelligent
: They have personal maturity ... able to focus on others at times when appropriate
: They are a good listener



'''If you could imagine a group of these people ... what would they be doing?'''

: Raising children
: Gardening
: Having services
: Eating supper together once a week
: Taking care of each others children
: Sharing books and poetry
: Sharing clothing (hand-me-downs) and toys
: Sharing large tools
: Helping each other garden
: Watching each others pets



'''Inviting groups that already exist to Kindred 2010'''

: I feel like we should just be getting to know our neighbors ... the neighbor you are seeking already exists in the neighbor you have
: Others
:: Daybreak
:: Trillium hollow
:: Buckman Neighborhood Association
:: Windward
:: Mothers Groups (The one at childroots annex), Probably the UUs have something like a women's group
